item.title: Announcing the Centre for Cryptographic Trust Infrastructure (CCTI)
item.description: 🚀 Exciting news! The Centre for Cryptographic Trust Infrastructure (CCTI) has been established, funded by a £2.4m grant from ARIA. This initiative is a collaboration between the University of Cambridge, the SINE Foundation, Ink & Switch, and Light Squares. CCTI aims to enhance secure coordination for AI agents in both digital and physical realms.
